assets.name: Rina
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent character animation sprite sheet for a professional AI interview room in a web app.

Create ONE EXACTLY SQUARE image containing a precision 2 by 2 grid of four equally sized animation frames. No gutters, borders, divider lines, labels, text or background. Each quadrant is exactly 50% width and 50% height of the image. The entire image background must be truly transparent alpha.

Subject: Rina, an original warm Indonesian woman in her early 30s working as an HR interviewer. Medium warm brown skin, kind expressive dark brown eyes, gently rounded adult facial features, dusty rose hijab neatly draped around head and shoulders, modest navy professional blouse. Appealing, polished, credible and welcoming. No jewelry or props.

Style: cinematic, feature-animation-quality stylized 3D, in the spirit of modern Disney/Pixar family films, with an original character design, refined facial geometry, softly realistic skin and woven fabric materials. Professional adult proportions, not chibi, no caricature. Warm soft studio key light, subtle fill, consistent light across all frames.

LOCKED CAMERA AND REGISTRATION: a straight-on front-facing bust portrait. Identical camera, identical head and shoulder position, identical body pose, identical scale and silhouette, identical lighting in all four frames. The portrait is duplicated in place, with ONLY eyelids and mouth changing. Face centered horizontally within EACH quadrant, top of hijab 5% below the top of EACH quadrant. Entire head, hijab, both shoulders and upper chest contained inside EACH cell; crop the torso only at each cell's lower boundary. Keep shoulder edges inside the cell with small transparent side margins. No head tilt, no body turn, no pose changes. ALL FOUR FRAMES PERFECTLY ALIGNED for flicker-free CSS sprite animation.

Frame order, fixed:
TOP LEFT: neutral attentive, eyes fully open, mouth gently closed.
TOP RIGHT: natural blink, both eyelids fully shut, same gently closed mouth.
BOTTOM LEFT: speaking, eyes open, mouth slightly open in a small relaxed vowel.
BOTTOM RIGHT: speaking, eyes open, mouth a little wider open, still restrained and professional.

Do not include hands. Do not include a background, floor, shadow plane, office, colored rectangle, contact sheet borders, text, logos or watermarks. Exactly FOUR isolated bust renders of the SAME identity, one per equal quadrant. Four equal squares in one square image, no gutters. Prioritize perfect matching scale and registration.

assets.name: Office background
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide background image for an AI interview video-call tile, placed behind a separate transparent bust portrait.

Primary request: a softly blurred warm neutral professional office in a refined stylized 3D animated-family-film visual style. NO PEOPLE anywhere.

Scene: understated modern Indonesian office or meeting room, warm ivory plaster walls, a quiet pale oak cabinet, a soft green indoor plant near the right edge, a few muted books without lettering on a distant shelf, soft daylight entering a simple window on the left. Calm, welcoming, professional, no clutter.

Composition: wide landscape 16:9 image, fixed eye-level front-facing camera. Leave the central 65% of the image visually quiet, with only an out-of-focus warm wall and subtle natural daylight tonal variation, suitable for a large foreground interviewer's head and shoulders. Only subtle office detail near outer edges. Lower part remains softly neutral for the character's shoulders. This is a virtual meeting background.

Style and lighting: cinematic, film-quality stylized 3D materials with subtle warmth, soft indirect light, shallow depth of field and moderate optical defocus across all background elements. Elegant restrained palette of ivory, pale oak and muted sage. Warm but not orange. Bright enough for navy/teal/charcoal clothing to read clearly. No dramatic shadows.

Constraints: no people, silhouettes, avatars, faces, hands, screens, UI, charts, writing, signage, logos, watermarks, image border or text. No decorative glow, no floating objects. Full bleed opaque background.

confirmed: One original character identity per sheet
Each sheet square, divided into four equal quadrant cells
Neutral and blink closed-mouth frames plus two visible speaking-mouth variations
Front-facing professional bust portraits with matching lighting and similar framing
All three PNG sheets have genuine alpha transparency
No text, logos, watermarks, props or hands
Office background has no people and a quiet central wall
Project copies match delivered output copies by SHA-256
visual_qa.usage_note: Frame registration is generated rather than pixel-identical; tiny expression-related changes are normal. Use restrained blink and mouth changes with idle transform motion.

design_reason: Warm original Indonesian 3D interviewers make the meeting feel welcoming and keep each persona recognizable; shared office lighting creates one coherent interview setting.
